title: Pushing the Limits of High-Resolution Weather Forecasting through Data Scaling
abstract: arXiv:2608.14652v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The development of 0.1$^{\circ}$ global weather forecasting models based on machine learning (ML) is constrained by the limited availability of high-resolution data, as decades of reanalysis are only available at 0.25$^{\circ}$ resolution. While existing approaches fine-tune 0.25$^{\circ}$ forecast models on limited 0.1$^{\circ}$ samples, we show that this transfer is hindered by the irreversible information loss inherent in coarse-resolution forecasting. Therefore, we propose BaguanHR, a framework that shifts the focus from transferring models to transferring data. We first show that super-resolution (SR) has lower conditional entropy and input amplification than forecasting, making it a more robust vehicle for resolution transfer. By leveraging this advantage through variable-wise SR, we synthesize extensive 0.1$^{\circ}$ data from ERA5. BaguanHR's performance on the synthetic-plus-real dataset exceeds both ML-based methods and IFS-H

translated_title: 推动高分辨率天气预报极限：通过数据扩展策略
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.14652v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：基于机器学习（ML）的0.1°全球天气预报模型的发展受到高分辨率数据可用性有限的制约，因为数十年的再分析数据仅以0.25°分辨率提供。虽然现有方法在有限的0.1°样本上微调0.25°预报模型，但我们表明这种迁移受到粗分辨率预报固有不可逆信息损失的阻碍。因此，我们提出BaguanHR框架，将重点从模型迁移转向数据迁移。我们首先表明，超分辨率（SR）比预报具有更低的条件熵和输入放大效应，使其成为更稳健的分辨率迁移载体。通过利用这一优势进行逐变量SR，我们从ERA5合成了广泛的0.1°数据。BaguanHR在合成加真实数据集上的性能超过了基于ML的方法和IFS-H。
tldr: BaguanHR通过将重点从模型迁移转向数据迁移，利用超分辨率的低条件熵优势合成高分辨率数据，从而突破0.1°天气预报的数据瓶颈。
en_tdlr: BaguanHR shifts focus from model transfer to data transfer, leveraging super-resolution's low conditional entropy to synthesize high-resolution data, breaking the data bottleneck for 0.1° weather forecasting.
